lang.title: Pick your language
net.waking: We dey wake Sentri up. E fit take reach one minute.
auth.session_ended: Your session don end, so protection don pause. Sign in again make e start again.
phone.title: Your phone number
phone.help: We go send code come your Telegram make we sure say na you. We no go share your number.
phone.invalid: This no be correct phone number. Check am, try again.
otp.title: Put the 6-number code
otp.format: The code na 6 numbers. Check am, try again.
otp.invalid: The code no correct or e don expire.
contacts.title: Emergency people
contacts.help: Dis people dey get your alert. Dem go ask each one make e accept. Person wey refuse no go dey get your alert again.
contacts.invalid: Check the phone numbers. Each one must dey correct and different.
pins.title: Your safety PIN
perm.title: Make Sentri work even when phone lock
perm.battery: No let phone kill Sentri for background
home.hold_help: Hold for 1 second. You fit also shake phone, press volume button, or use the floating button.
triggers.title: Ways to call for help
triggers.power_note: E no dey work for every phone brand.
sos.active: Alert dey active. We dey share where you dey.
sos.offline: No network. Your alert don save, e go go as network come back.
sos.responding: Person dey come help you. Stay safe.
sos.contacts_busy: You no fit change contacts while alert dey active.
map.unknown_place: We no get the place name
map.finding: We dey find where you dey...
map.approx_hint: Your phone dey give rough position. To get exact one: on GPS, set Sentri location to Precise, then go outside or stand near window.
map.no_location: Put location on make you see where you dey.
police.note: Official Nigeria Police Force numbers for every state and FCT. If one no pick, call 112.
contacts.declined_note: Person refuse. Add another person make at least three fit help you.
contacts.load_failed: We no fit load your people. Check your network.
inbox.title: Messages
inbox.none: Notin dey here yet. Alerts from people wey pick you go show here.
inbox.failed: E no load. Pull down make you try again.
inbox.scam_note: Sentri no dey ever text you alert or link. Any text wey talk say na Sentri send am na fake.
inbox.test_sent: Test don go to {n} of your contacts.
inbox.test_none: None of your contacts get Sentri yet.
inbox.test_wait: You fit send another test after few minutes.
share.title: Share location
share.help: Choose who fit follow you live. Dem go hear when you start and when you stop.
share.limit_note: Sharing go stop by itself when this time end, so e no go dey on by mistake.
share.live_note: Your contacts don hear. Dem go hear again when you stop.
share.invite_text: I add you as my emergency contact for Sentri. Install the app make I fit alert you if danger come.
share.none_reachable: None of dem get Sentri yet.
share.stop_pending: E dey stop. E go finish once network come back.
contacts.app_only: Alerts dey reach contacts inside the app with ringing notification. People wey no get Sentri no fit hear, so invite dem.
police.near_you: Call police wey dey near you
police.near_them: Call police wey dey near am
police.approx: Di police command wey near this place pass, we pick am by distance. Na Nigeria Police Force official numbers be these. If one no pick, call 112.
police.cant_dial: Phone app no open. Dial the number by hand.
police.none_found: We no see police number for this area.
police.waiting: We dey wait for location. You fit still call 112.
otp.send_failed: We no fit send the code. Check the number, try again small time.
otp.too_many: You don ask for too many codes. Try again after one hour.
otp.test_code: Test mode: your code na {code}. Tap to put am.
otp.telegram_sent: Collect your code for {phone} for Telegram.
otp.telegram_hint: For Telegram, tap Start, then tap Share my number. Your code go land for that chat. Come back here type am.
sos.police_note: You need police? Call 112 or the line wey close below.
